Long-Term investing strategy

When the crypto market is falling, buying feels scary. When it's going up, it feels like you've already missed your chance.

As a result, most people either buy based on emotion or keep waiting for the perfect entry point — and end up doing nothing at all.

But there's a simple way to avoid this problem: invest a fixed amount of money at regular intervals.

This strategy is called DCA (Dollar-Cost Averaging).

You simply choose the asset, the amount you want to invest, and how often you want to buy.

For example:
$50 worth of Bitcoin every week.

When Bitcoin is cheaper, your $50 buys more. When it's more expensive, it buys less. Over time, your average purchase price naturally evens out, and over the course of a few years, it often ends up being better than the average market participant's.

Bybit even has a built-in Auto-Invest bot designed specifically for this strategy. You set it up once — choose your currency, the coin, the investment amount, and the schedule.

After that, your purchases happen automatically, whether it's every day or once a month. The key is to choose a coin you genuinely believe in for the long term.

For long-term investors, the key takeaway is simple: market bottoms are built through accumulation, not perfect timing.

Last night’s Evening of Bible Prophecy in Adelaide was a huge blessing to me, and I know it was to Pastor Barry as well.

We were truly blown away by the outpouring of love and support from Navigate Church - from Pastors Lyndon and Lochie, with whom we enjoyed a wonderful lunch that sparked the idea of hosting a National Young Adults Prophecy Conference next time, all the way to the incredible Navigate team and the many people who came. Some flew in from Sydney, while others drove more than 12 hours just to be with us.

The place was packed, the organization was flawless, the worship was powerful, and above all, the sweet fellowship we shared made it feel like one big family.

We shared messages filled with the Word of God, equipping the saints with the truth that is so desperately needed in these last days.

We are excited to know that our Adelaide experience wasn’t the end of something, but the birth of something new and exciting for the future.

As I write these words, we are on our way to our final stop here in Australia - Perth. It is also the final stop on my nearly seven-week speaking tour around the world.

We are looking forward to breaking bread with local pastors tomorrow ahead of our Discovering Daniel conference on Saturday.

As always, I want to thank everyone who prayed for us, encouraged us, and supported this ministry. Your prayers, generosity, and faithful partnership make it possible for us to continue proclaiming God’s Word around the world without compromise.

To God be all the glory!

Awaiting His Soon Return,

Amir
